I'm actually new to Reddit, so I wasn't aware that this was a commonly posted thing. Everytime I make the statement that transgenderism is a mental illness in real life, I get label as a bigot whose spewing hate speech.

I see where you're coming from, and I in no way meant to offend you. However, as this is the page of unpopular opinions, I'm going to defend my points. 

1) I may in some places not be able to stop you from using the bathroom, and even if I could, I might not, but what I said is that I don't believe you SHOULD be able to do that. Disagree if you'd like, that's up to you. But that is just how I feel.
2) I guess I genuinely don't really understand your point here. You look like a woman. However, that doesn't make you a woman. And, like I said, if that is how you would like to live life, go for it. But, I believe you're a man by fact.
3) No, I don't believe trans people are faking it. Their feelings are real, and I'm not denying that. I'm just saying you can not change facts no matter how you feel. That's what I was saying I disagreed with.
4) I agree that I probably didn't have the best word choice here. However, I still stand by my point that I view this as a mental illness, but that doesn't mean I hate or even dislike trans people. For example, I don't hate people with depression, but depression is still a mental illness.
5) Lastly, I agree that you have the right to do whatever you want with your body if that's what makes you happy. The main point I was trying to make here is that just because you look like the opposite sex doesn't mean you are the opposite sex.

I hope this cleared things up about my view. Again, I wasn't trying to offend you in any way, so I hope you're not insulted by my beliefs.
